defs.def: to respect sb for what they are or for what they have done 钦佩；赞赏；仰慕

ex.s: Admiring the beauty of art may be the ideal way to initiate the abstract cognitive processes.”
ex.t: 欣赏艺术之美或许是启动抽象认知过程的理想方式。”

ex.s: “Do you know?” she said, “I’ve always admired you.
ex.t: 我也许能轻易获得关注，但你拥有稳步成长的力量。

ex.s: There’s voluntary rereading, the result of a willful decision to revisit a book one has admired, or a book that has left one with some unanswered questions.

Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 受神经美学的启发，下次创作艺术时，我将更加重视创作过程，在欣赏我创造的生动图像的同时，享受大脑审美三元组的激活。

ex.s: In Samarkand, Mr Bissell admires the architectural wonders, while on his way to Bukhara he gets a taste of police methods when suspected of drug dealing.
ex.t: 在撒马尔罕比塞尔先生欣赏建筑奇迹而在前往布哈拉的路上他因涉嫌毒品交易而尝到了警察手段的滋味。

ex.s: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, family members often gather together _________ a meal, admire the moon and enjoy moon cakes.
ex.t: 在任何不安全的情况下，只需按下按钮，训练有素的工作人员就会为你提供所需的帮助。

defs.def: to look at sth and think that it is attractive and/or impressive 欣赏

ex.s: Today, the Longji Rice Terraces attract thousands of visitors who come to admire this great wonder created by people and nature working together.
ex.t: 如今，龙脊水稻梯田吸引了成千上万的游客前来欣赏这座由人与自然共同创造的伟大奇迹。

ex.s: Scott Fitzgerald’s most admired work will find themselves glued to their screens by episodes of The Great Gatsby.
ex.t: 斯科特·菲茨杰拉德（ Scott Fitzgerald ）最受尊敬的作品将被《了不起的盖茨比》（ The Great Gatsby ）的剧集粘在屏幕

ex.s: I try to take every opportunity to get outside and admire the natural world.
ex.t: 我尽量利用一切机会走出去，欣赏自然世界。

ex.s: Which of his qualities do you admire most?
ex.t: 您最欣赏他的哪些品质？

ex.s: Rewrite the underlined sentences using the -ed form.] Ryan is a young man who is admired by a lot of people.
ex.t: 使用-ed形式重写带下划线的句子。] Ryan是一个受到很多人钦佩的年轻人。
